meta.title: 0.5.5 Fubgun Flameblast Oil Grenade
meta.author: Fubgun
meta.pob: single spec, level 98, treeVersion 0_5, 157 nodes; PlayerStat: Life 3257, Armour 80088, Evasion 9231, EvadeChance 50, PhysicalDamageReduction 89, Spirit 150 (unreserved -4), Str 135 Dex 64 Int 155 (Req Str 116 Dex 76 Int 150), all res 75, IgniteDPS 15.08M, Cooldown 10.032 -> matches the DoT Cap variant, not lvl 53-68/85/Endgame

text.BuildOverview: This is my [Flameblast] / [Oil Grenade] build for 0.5.5, trying to focus on speed and clear, as this build already has a ton of damage built in. Opting for a [Cast on Dodge] setup with gemling for a speedy setup. You'll level as the very powerful grenade merc setup and once you reach lvl 52 you'll swap to [Flameblast], you cannot swap any earlier because [Flameblast] is a lvl 52 gem.
text.HowItWorks_FAQ: Issues with oil grenade not igniting or not dealing damage: 1) You cannot have flat fire damage or extra fire damage anywhere on your gear (the only exception is your staff). 2) Make sure your weapon swap is setup correctly. Flameblast on weapon set 1 and oil grenade on weapon set 2. 3) If you're doing a map with burning ground you have to takeout tornado from your cast on dodge and replace it with another spell (like frost bomb). 4) You have to press oil grenades into flameblast and your flameblast has to hit a target. Keep in mind on bosses, you don't have 100% chance to ignite and it could take 2 flameblast. Higher damage/higher flammability magnitude does help with this. 5) You're getting ignited and it's overriding your ignite on oil grenade, make sure to always use a [Dousing Charm]. 6) [Headhunter] is not good for this build and the buffs it provides can brick your ignite. -How do I get more skill slots? With [Unset Ring]s and [Augmented Flesh]. You can snapshot skill slots. Put on your rings/amulet, equip your skills and than take them off. While you wont be able to use the skills, they will still count for stuff like [Gem Studded] and [Essence of Virtue]. To balance [Gem Studded], just make sure all the gems at the top are equal, but exclude gems in your staff skill as those do not count towards the total amount. -Where do you get all of your gem quality from? 5% from [Fox Idol]; 5% from [Paragon] Anoint; 5% From Amulet suffix (desecrated modifier); 6% from gemling small ascendancy nodes; 20-23% from Gem quality. This will give you in total 41-44% quality. 40% quality is pretty important as it's a breakpoint for some skills, [Arctic Armour] armour will gain 1 stage (and another +1 stage if you get gem lvl 27, for a total of 8). Quality is also a massive damage multiplier for [Flameblast].
text.v3_swap_description: This is the [Flameblast] Swap, you'll want a decent staff (+fire skills), 30k~ gold to respec your passive tree and enough uncut skill/support gems. Keep in mind there's no rush to swap, you can finish the campaign as grenades, if you didn't get any GCP or don't have a good weapon, than just stay as grenades for a bit longer. Mandatory For swap to feel good: one lvl 13 skill gem for [Flameblast]; 2-4 Gemcutter's prism (the quality is massive for [Flameblast] with gemling); Greater jeweller's orb for [Flameblast] (one is guaranteed in Ngakanu in act 4); Lesser jeweller's orb for [Oil Grenade] (pretty plentiful, ideally a 2nd Greater would be nice); Good weapon (+3 or +4 with inc spell damage or inc fire damage); 9~ uncut support gems for your new skills; 3 uncut skill gems for [Tornado], [Frost Bomb] and [Elemental Weakness]; 1 uncut spirit gem. Make sure to properly setup your weapon set for [Flameblast] and [Oil Grenade] (flameblast on weapon set 1 and oil grenade on weapon set 2, and also follow the points correctly on the tree). Important: Do Not have Flat fire damage to attacks anywhere or it can brick your build. You can always check your oil grenade to see if it has any fire damage. (Extra fire damage is fine on the staff because you'll never have it out when using oil grenade). Note: Trial 3 for sekhema's can feel rather challenging on this build, I would either do it first on grenades or swap to flameblast and just get your third ascend through ultimatum. You can get 2 guaranteed Gemcutter's prism from campaign if it's not changed from 0.5, The first one is in act 2 Keth and 2nd one is from act 4 Isle of kin (will have to do the league mechanic in those zones, so ritual).
text.v4_description: same as v3 swap description minus the Trial 3 note
text.v6_description: This is a higher budget version, the lvl 85 version can already comfortable clear all content. You can push even farther if you opt for a full armour/mageblood setup to be extremely tanky.
text.v2_description: Starting from lvl 36, you'll want to be checking the vendor every few lvls and picking up every staff, because this is when +4 fire staffs can start dropping, which is extremely important to have if you want to swap to flameblast at lvl 52.
text.v0_description: Keep in mind this build will require a respec at lvl 52, which will cost around 30k~ gold, so don't waste gold in campaign. Vendor Regex: "!Item Class: (One Hand Maces|Two Hand Maces|Quarterstaves|Spears|Bows|Quivers|Shields|Bucklers|Sceptres|Foci|Wands)" "s: (am|ri|be|Cross)|movem|[edgl] to.attack|[2-4]\d% to.*res|to.*(int|dex)|^\+.*all sp.*ls$|^\+.*re sp.*ls$" Lvling filter: https://www.pathofexile.com/item-filter/rkyBKzHX Only use until you get to maps.
text.v4_equip_desc: For campaign ... basic gear with life+resist, generally resist is more important. For rings/gloves, these are pretty good pieces to pickup flat damage to attacks ... As for bases, armour/energy shield is generally what you aim for, but life/resist are more important. Weapon: You're not a spellcaster and only care for spell damage stats, your crossbow stats do not matter. As for your staff you want the highest +lvl staff you can find, followed by spell dmg/fire damage/fire magnitude. For boots you're looking for movement speed ... Body armour ... high armour or armour/evasion hybrid ... Flask: upgrade life/mana flask (lvl 10, 16, 23, 30, 40, 50 and 60). Dousing charm: This is pretty important and a must have. If you get ignited, that ignite can spread to your oil grenade and brick your snapshot (you'll do 0 damage). So make sure to always use this charm. Anoint: [Burnout]. [Paragon] is the best anoint, but might be expensive early on.
text.v4_gems_desc: Get [Flameblast] to 20 quality first and than [Cast on Dodge] (this will give you a lot of mobility). As soon as you get 100 spirit (which you get naturally in campaign) You'll want to use [Cast on Dodge]. It's still good to have a castable [Tornado] on your bars as well, as it can come in handy for flying monsters. Remember to keep lvling up [Frost Bomb] and [Elemental Weakness] or they wont work vs high lvl enemies.
text.v4v5v6_tree_desc: Because you travel so far on the tree, your attributes should generally be pretty free. You need high enough intelligence for [Flameblast], but it shouldn't be an issue to solve all attributes as this build. You'll want every jewel with flammability magnitude, these can roll on ruby jewels or sapphire jewels. Ailments inflict damage faster is also a strong stat. Ascendancy order: [Essence of Virtue] -> [Advanced Thaumaturgy] -> [Implanted Gems](int) -> [Gem Studded]
text.v5_equip_desc: Gear: It's really simple and easy to gear this character, you just want Life/resist and rarity on every single piece. %inc fire damage is nice on rings, but it's a small boost and not needed. Also keep in mind, strength is always a good suffix because it provides life, you have a lot of free affixes on this build. You're also going to stack both ward and life, to get the highest amount of ward you want to use Tier 1 bases of any hybrid base. I prefer ES/armour or pure int bases, just to give us the highest pool. Armour is not that effective until you start actually starting it so just focus on pure life/ward. [Morior Invictus (life)] is a great chest option, specially if you can pickup a 5 socket one with life per socket, combined with [Perfect Body Rune] you can get a ton of life. Other good options with life would be all resist, chaos resist or spirit. If you need spirit you can also use [Soul Core of Azcapa] in your crossbow. [Blackflame] is another item you can go for, we bypass the downside and get a massive ignite magnitude. It's a good early pickup, but eventually you would want to replace it with a triple rarity gold ring. If you do use black flame, make sure you also use [Withering Presence]. Dousing charm: (same). Amulet: [Surefooted Sigil] is the go to for speed at the start. Swap to a rare [Gold Amulet] when you can afford a 5% quality with [Paragon] Anointed. Anoint: [Paragon] is the best anoint, but might be expensive early on. [Burnout] is a cheaper option if paragon is too expensive.
text.v5_gems_desc: You have 1 decision you can make here, you can either go for a [Temporal Chains]/[Blasphemy] setup or use [Mana Remnants] for [Khatal's Rejuvenation], as this will provide more CDR and near infinite mana. If you opt for [Blackflame] you'll want to use [Withering Presence] with [Prolonged Duration II] and [Chaos Mastery]. Because we're gemling, it's important we balance our gem colors for [Gem Studded], it's not hard to setup you can just equip any crossbow skills and than just use any support gem of any color until you have all 3 equal. This will also count the gems in your weapon swap.
text.v6_equip_desc: (same Gear/ward/Morior/Azcapa/Blackflame text as v5) Amulet: You can go for a [Cast on Dodge] [Absent Amulet] amulet, as this will provide even more dodge roll distance with our global quality, use the same links as the regular cast on dodge setup. The other option is using a [Gold Amulet], which will be a lot cheaper as well. Dousing charm: (same). Anoint: [Paragon] is the best anoint. At this point you can start making your 5 prop jewels, these will give a massive amount of damage: Ideal 5 prop: Prefix 1: Mag of ailments you inflict 15%; Prefix 2: Ignite magnitude 15%; Prefix 3: Spell dmg or elemental damage (% armour or %Es can also be good if you scale your build for those). Suffix 1: +1 prefix modifier; Suffix 2: Damaging ailments deal damage 7% faster
text.v6_gems_desc: (same as v5) + Keep in mind the blasphemy setup will require more spirit to use. + the skill slot FAQ (Unset Ring / Augmented Flesh; exclude staff skill gems)
text.v0_equip_desc_relevant: Save all Gemcutters Prism (GCP), these are mandatory for [Flameblast] swap at lvl 52. You'll also need to Save a couple of skill gems/support gems for the swap at lvl 52.

virtuous_barrier.effect_en: Persistent buff. Gains a random Mote every (1.53—2) s; loses a random Mote when Hit. Maximum of each Attribute of Mote is 3 plus the number of Skills you have which require that Attribute; Single-Attribute Skills grant twice as many maximum Motes. 2% increased maximum Life per Strength Mote; 5% increased Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield per Dexterity Mote; 5% increased Life and Mana Regeneration rate per Intelligence Mote. Quality: (0—2.5)% increased Life/Mana Regeneration per Int Mote
virtuous_barrier.effect_cn: 激活时，召唤一面闪烁的屏障，随时间积累每种属性类型的保护性宝石尘埃，但当你被击中时会失去一个随机尘埃。每 (1.53—2) 秒获得一个随机微粒。每种属性的微粒上限为 3，并额外增加等同于你拥有的且为该属性需求的技能数量；单属性技能赋予双倍微粒上限。每有一点力量微粒，生命上限提高 2%；每有一点敏捷微粒，护甲，闪避与能量护盾提高 5%；每点智慧微粒使生命回复速度提高 5%、魔力回复速度提高 5%
